asChild.description:
Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

Use `render` when you need the part's state: `render={(props, state) => <MyButton {...props} />}`.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Pass an element to have the part's props merged into it, or a function to control the merge
yourself and read the part's state.

defaultValue.description:
The initial value to be copied to the clipboard when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the clipboard.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the clipboard. Useful for composition.

onStatusChange.description: The function to be called when the copied status changes, or copying fails

onValueChange.description: The function to be called when the value changes
